result.stdout:
 ─────────────────────────
 Amafu Cloud Bootstrap CLI
 ─────────────────────────
Commands:                 detect, init, reconcile  
  amafu detect [--json] [--create-links] [--dry-run] [--onedrive-personal <folder>]
  amafu init [--dry-run] [-f|--force] [--create-links] [--onedrive-personal <folder>]
  amafu reconcile [--apply|--dry-run] [--onedrive-personal <folder>]
-h, --help                print out all options  
-v, --version             print version info  
-n, --nologo              do not display the banner  
-f, --force               overwrite an existing configuration  
--dry-run                 preview detection or configuration without writing  
--json                    print machine-readable cloud detection  
--onedrive-personal       select a personal OneDrive folder; default keeps the configured root, otherwise longest name wins  
--create-links            create ~/.CloudStorage/<provider> shortcuts  
Configuration             ~/.config/RAIkeep.json5
